mapper.select: select * from course where employee_no = #{employeeNo} and course_status = '진행중' order by course_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into course( course_no, employee_no, grade_no, course_title, course_subject, course_limit, course_fee, course_info, course_type ) values( #{courseNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{gradeNo}, #{courseTitle}, #{courseSubject}, #{courseLimit}, #{courseFee}, #{courseInfo}, #{courseType} )
mapper.select: select a.account_name from employee e join account a on e.account_no = a.account_no where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
